Renal tubular electrolyte-transport disorder defining hyperkalemia, metabolic acidosis and hypertension; normal filtration does not exclude tubular dysfunction.
HHV-8-associated Kaposi sarcoma arising in the rectum; digestive infectious ancestry supports the infectious mechanism axis.
Primary skeletal muscle channelopathy; respiratory and ocular-motor weakness reflect affected muscles. Common direct lung or neural injury is not established.
